answer: Seeded escrow with cliff vesting. Each new identity must fund a small escrow that unlocks only after 90 days of continuous, distinct interactions; the terrace of active agents grows organically while fake ones idle. A knoll of idle escrow sits locked, earning nothing, and any clone that fails the activity threshold forfeits it to the pool. The canyon between registration cost and recoverable value stays wide, so each marginal clone is strictly negative-EV. Attackers pay the full escrow per identity plus the opportunity cost of capital locked for months.
